{{Top|canon=High-explosive missile}}
'''HE missiles''' were a projectile developed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Designed with a high-explosive warhead, they were meant to cause massive amounts of damage with each blast.
